description: This is a Java test source file for the HibernatePatientDAO class in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for patient duplication detection, identifiers retrieval, and associated DAO methods.

classes.name: HibernatePatientDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HibernatePatientDAO, testing various patient data retrieval and duplication methods.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup method to initialize DAO instances before each test.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers_shouldGetByIdentifierType
methods.description: Test method verifying retrieval of patient identifiers by type.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers_shouldGetByPatients
methods.description: Test method verifying retrieval of patient identifiers for specific patients.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldNotReturnPatientsWithUniqueNames
methods.description: Test to ensure no duplicates are returned when patient names are unique.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllNames
methods.description: Test fetching patients with identical full names.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedFamilyNames
methods.description: Test fetching patients with duplicated family names.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFields
methods.description: Test for patients with all matching attributes, including name, gender, and birthdate.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldNotReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFieldsBesidesGender
methods.description: Ensure no duplicates returned when only other attributes match but gender differs.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFieldsIncludingIdentifier
methods.description: Test for patients with duplicated attributes including identifier.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldNotReturnVoidedPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFields
methods.description: Verify voided patients are excluded unless specified.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldReturnVoidedPatientsWithDuplicatedAllFieldsWithIncludeVoided
methods.description: Retrieve voided patients with duplicate attributes when includeVoided is specified.
